title: Scoped key taxonomy, dynamic expiry policies, and non-disruptive SDK rotation
creator: Aisha Khatri
description: Introduce a scoped key taxonomy and dynamic expiry policies plus an SDK-side non-disruptive rotation helper to reduce blast radius of leaked credentials and make per-scope keys easy for engineers to adopt.
background: Current token model mixes long-lived service keys and user-scoped tokens with inconsistent naming and no standard TTL policies. This causes high operational burden when rotating keys, poor auditability for cross-team service accounts, and ad-hoc workarounds that bypass RBAC v2 intent. Several recent postmortems noted slow emergency rotation workflows and unclear ownership for service keys.
goals: Define a hierarchical naming taxonomy for service and ephemeral keys to make ownership and scope discoverable
Implement dynamic expiry policy engine (policy templates + per-key overrides) in auth-service
Ship SDK rotation helpers that support in-process overlapping credentials (grace window) to avoid client outages during rotation
Surface audit events and key lifecycle changes in Console and centralized logs for compliance
acceptance_criteria: Auth-service accepts new 'policy_template' field on key create and enforces TTL and rotation reminders
All newly issued service keys follow taxonomy: org.team.purpose.environment.unique-id and are searchable in Console
SDK helpers (Go/TS/Python) demonstrate zero-downtime rotation in integration tests with KV cache warmup
Audit logs contain structured fields: action, actor, key_id, old_scope, new_scope, expiry_before, expiry_after, reason
A migration playbook exists for transitioning selected teams to scoped keys with rollback steps and monitoring dashboards

decision_log: 2026-02-27: Chose hierarchical dotted taxonomy over UUID-only naming to make ownership searchable and human-readable
2026-03-02: Policy engine will support 3 tiers of TTL templates (ephemeral: 1h-24h, short: 1-30d, long: 90-365d) with per-key override allowed only by org-admins
2026-03-04: Rotation grace window default set to 5 minutes for short-lived tokens, 30 minutes for short TTL keys, 24 hours for long TTLs — configurable per template
2026-03-07: Audit logs will emit structured JSON lines with a stable schema v1.0 stored in readonly append-only index for 1 year
rollout_plan: Week 1: Launch auth-service policy API behind feature flag for internal Platform team; deploy SDK beta
Week 2: Pilot with 2 platform services; collect metrics (failed auth, rotation success rate, ops tickets)
Week 3: Open Console search & lifecycle UI to alpha orgs and run migration playbook with rollback window
Week 4: Gradual org-wide roll with alerting thresholds and emergency-revoke runbook validated
